name: whatson-api
description: What's on? API to retrieve movies and tvshows

scripts.update-packages: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && ncu -u --reject newrelic && npm install
scripts.check-dataset: bash src/data/checkIds.sh check_dataset movie $HEAD_NUMBER $EXCLUDED_IDS_MOVIE && bash src/data/checkIds.sh check_dataset tvshow $HEAD_NUMBER $EXCLUDED_IDS_TVSHOW
scripts.check-local-with-remote-ids: node src/data/updateData.js movie no_update_ids update_db local no_active check 0 no_force skip_mojo skip_services && node src/data/updateData.js tvshow no_update_ids update_db local no_active check 0 no_force skip_mojo skip_services
scripts.update-local: npm run update-local-movie && npm run update-local-tvshow
scripts.update-local-stop-movie: bash src/data/getIds.sh local movie stop imdb
scripts.update-local-stop-tvshow: bash src/data/getIds.sh local tvshow stop imdb
scripts.update-local-stop: npm run update-local-stop-movie && npm run update-local-stop-tvshow
scripts.update-dataset: bash src/data/checkIds.sh check movie && bash src/data/checkIds.sh check tvshow
scripts.update-active-dataset: bash src/data/checkIds.sh check movie active && bash src/data/checkIds.sh check tvshow active
scripts.update-all-ids-dataset: npm run update-all-ids-dataset-movie && npm run update-all-ids-dataset-tvshow
scripts.confirm-dataset: npm run confirm-dataset-movie && npm run confirm-dataset-tvshow
scripts.pull-all-platforms: git pull origin main && git pull bitbucket main && git pull bitbucket_2 main && git pull bitbucket_3 main
scripts.push-all-platforms: git push origin main && git push bitbucket main && git push bitbucket_2 main && git push bitbucket_3 main
scripts.push: npm run check-api-version && npm run check-static-usage && npm run prettier && npm run test && npm run commit && npm run push-all-platforms
scripts.push-sync: npm run check-api-version && npm run check-static-usage && npm run prettier && npm run test-sync && npm run commit && npm run push-all-platforms
scripts.push-dataset: npm run prettier && npm run test && git add . && git commit -m 'build: update dataset' && npm run push-all-platforms
scripts.push-without-tests: npm run check-api-version && npm run prettier && npm run commit && npm run push-all-platforms
scripts.push-without-version: npm run prettier && npm run test && npm run commit && npm run push-all-platforms
scripts.push-without-tests-and-version: npm run prettier && npm run commit && npm run push-all-platforms
scripts.sync-launch: launchctl print gui/$(stat -f%u /dev/console)/com.whatson.api.sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || launchctl bootstrap gui/$(stat -f%u /dev/console) "$(eval echo ~$(stat -f%Su /dev/console))/Library/LaunchAgents/com.whatson.api.sync.plist"
scripts.update-all-movie-data: node ./src/data/updateData.js movie no_update_ids update_db circleci no_active no_check_db_ids 0 force no_skip_mojo no_skip_services no_delete 7 1000000000 all_ids
scripts.update-all-tvshow-data: node ./src/data/updateData.js tvshow no_update_ids update_db circleci no_active no_check_db_ids 0 force no_skip_mojo no_skip_services no_delete 7 1000000000 all_ids
scripts.update-all-movie-data-local: node ./src/data/updateData.js movie no_update_ids update_db local no_active no_check_db_ids 0 force no_skip_mojo no_skip_services no_delete 7 1000000000 all_ids
scripts.update-all-tvshow-data-local: node ./src/data/updateData.js tvshow no_update_ids update_db local no_active no_check_db_ids 0 force no_skip_mojo no_skip_services no_delete 7 1000000000 all_ids
scripts.check-ids-before-update-all-ids: npm run update-local && npm run update-active-dataset && npm run confirm-dataset && npm run update-all-ids
scripts.check-ids-before-update-all-ids-force: npm run update-local && npm run update-active-dataset && npm run confirm-dataset && npm run update-all-ids-force
scripts.check-ids-and-stop-before-update-all-ids: npm run update-local-stop && npm run update-active-dataset && npm run confirm-dataset && npm run update-all-ids
npm run update-local-stop && npm run update-active-dataset && npm run confirm-dataset && npm run update-all-ids-force
scripts.update-all-ids-movie: node src/data/updateData.js movie update_ids update_db local active
scripts.update-all-ids-tvshow: node src/data/updateData.js tvshow update_ids update_db local active
scripts.update-all-ids: npm run update-all-ids-movie && npm run update-all-ids-tvshow && npm run test
scripts.update-all-ids-sync: npm run update-all-ids-movie && npm run update-all-ids-tvshow && npm run test-sync
scripts.update-all-ids-force-movie: node src/data/updateData.js movie update_ids update_db local active no_check_db_ids 0 force
scripts.update-all-ids-force-tvshow: node src/data/updateData.js tvshow update_ids update_db local active no_check_db_ids 0 force
scripts.update-all-ids-force: npm run update-all-ids-force-movie && npm run update-all-ids-force-tvshow && npm run test
scripts.update-all-active-ids-movie: node src/data/updateData.js movie no_update_ids update_db local active
scripts.update-all-active-ids-tvshow: node src/data/updateData.js tvshow no_update_ids update_db local active
scripts.update-all-active-ids-movie-force: node src/data/updateData.js movie no_update_ids update_db local active no_check_db_ids 0 force
scripts.update-all-active-ids-tvshow-force: node src/data/updateData.js tvshow no_update_ids update_db local active no_check_db_ids 0 force
scripts.update-all-active-ids: npm run update-all-active-ids-movie && npm run update-all-active-ids-tvshow && npm run test
scripts.update-all-non-active-ids-movie: node src/data/updateData.js movie no_update_ids update_db local no_active no_check_db_ids $INDEX force mojo no_skip_services no_delete_ids $DAYS_NUMBER $MAX_INDEX
scripts.update-all-non-active-ids-tvshow: node src/data/updateData.js tvshow no_update_ids update_db local no_active no_check_db_ids $INDEX force mojo no_skip_services no_delete_ids $DAYS_NUMBER $MAX_INDEX
scripts.update-all-non-active-ids: npm run update-all-non-active-ids-movie && npm run update-all-non-active-ids-tvshow && npm run test
scripts.update-all-non-active-and-top-ids: export MOJO_MAX_ITERATIONS=1 && node src/data/updateData.js movie no_update_ids update_db local no_active no_check_db_ids 0 force mojo no_skip_services no_delete_ids 0 1000000 all_ids && export MOJO_MAX_ITERATIONS=50
scripts.update-all-non-active-and-old-ids-movie: node src/data/updateData.js movie no_update_ids update_db local no_active no_check_db_ids 0 force mojo no_skip_services no_delete_ids 180 1000000 all_ids
scripts.update-all-non-active-and-old-ids-tvshow: node src/data/updateData.js tvshow no_update_ids update_db local no_active no_check_db_ids 0 force mojo no_skip_services no_delete_ids 60 1000000 all_ids
scripts.update-all-non-active-and-old-ids: npm run update-all-non-active-and-old-ids-movie && npm run update-all-non-active-and-old-ids-tvshow
